entries.definition: Naturally occurring ABO antibody (anti-A/anti-B), primarily IgM, present in plasma of individuals lacking the corresponding antigen.
Hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn — maternal IgG antibodies destroy fetal red cells (classically anti-D).
Elevated urea/creatinine in blood; classified as prerenal, intrinsic renal or postrenal.
Variation in red cell size; quantified by an elevated RDW.
Cylindrical structure formed in renal tubules; type indicates renal pathology (e.g., RBC casts = glomerulonephritis).
Multirule QC framework: 1_2s warning; 1_3s, 2_2s, R_4s (and others) rejection rules.
Overall strength of antigen-antibody binding considering multiple binding sites (vs affinity of a single site).
